_comment: The sales reps used for every per-rep goal, the Program Submissions table, quotas, and commission estimates. Matched to GHL users by userId (the id in GHL's user list); name and email are for readability only. kpiMultiplier scales every per-rep goal rate (1.0 = full-time, 0.5 = part-time); goalOverrides sets a fixed rate for one KPI instead (in the KPI's own unit: per week for weekly goals, per day for daily goals). monthlyQuota is combined submissions for the calendar month. commissionPlan names a plan in config/commission.json. Team-wide goals are the sum of each rep's goal. Everyone not listed here is grouped as 'Other users, not sales reps' and still counts in team totals. Owner decision 2026-10-13 (edits round 6). photo: a path under public/ to the rep's picture; shown as a circle on the Rep Performance cards, with initials when missing (added 2026-10-18). signInEmail (added 2026-10-26): the Google account the rep signs in with to see their own dashboard at /me; empty = the rep cannot sign in yet. The older email field is the address on the GHL user record and is informational only. startDate / endDate (added 2026-11-17): the rep's first and last day on the team (YYYY-MM-DD, New York, inclusive). Rep lists, leaderboards, goals, quotas, pace, and the reports use the reps on the team on the last day of the selected range (today for a period in progress); per-rep goals and the monthly quota are pro-rated to the days on the team; sign-in works only while on the team. Nothing is deleted: a former rep's activity, commission, and invoices through their last day stay visible for ranges that include those days.
